name: planetarium
description: Reconstructed source for the Planetarium procedural planet generator.

scripts.check: node --check src/app.js && node --check src/font_data.js && node --check desktop/main.cjs && node --check scripts/build-web.mjs && node --check scripts/serve.mjs && node scripts/check-assets.mjs
